description: Durable regression subset promoted from the semantic quality benchmark. These cases express general behavior categories; the assertions are encoded as principle-level tests in src-tauri/src/analysis/quality.rs (test_red_*) — no benchmark IDs or phrases are hardcoded in production code.

categories.terse_good_prompt: A short, self-contained transformation task with input anchor and output contract must not be crushed to a low score.
categories.keyword_stuffed_nonsense: Headings with nonsense bodies and meaningless numbered steps must not reach a high score.
categories.contradictory_prompt: Explicitly contradictory mandates must lower the score.
categories.cosmetic_heading_change: Adding empty headings/boilerplate without semantic improvement must not materially change the score.
categories.genuine_context_improvement: Adding genuinely required context must improve the score meaningfully.
categories.irrelevant_safety_boilerplate: Generic safety/compliance boilerplate on a harmless task must not inflate the score.
categories.guideline_routing: Guidelines (incl. English) must be routed to the guideline scoring model; task prompts must not.
categories.irrelevant_missing_info: Inapplicable criteria must not be reported as missing information.

cases.note: Calibration contrast-pair member A1/F-family; reference EXCELLENT.

Mutually exclusive output contracts; reference BROKEN.
Pair C1 vs C2: cosmetic formatting must not add >10 points.
Pair D1 vs D2: real context must add >=20 points.
